findings.problem: The hint contains the answer itself (llevo), so the learner just copies it instead of recalling it; an English-only hint would let estar (he estado) or hacer (hace dos años que...) fit, so it has to name and exclude them.
findings.fix: hint: the verb that counts time, as in 'I've been here two years', not estar or hace

back.es: llevar (with a length of time): to have been (doing something or somewhere) for that time; also to carry, to take, to wear
back.example: I've been waiting for two hours.

note: The hint now rules out the other two llevar cards (to take, to wear), since this prompt is about time, not carrying or clothing.
